title: The problem
lines: On every shift, technicians check equipment in plant rooms and basements.
Down there, there is often no signal.
Rounds brings AI to these inspections. But approved rules always decide what is safe.

title: Cloud compiles the manual
lines: A supervisor starts with the equipment manual. This one is fictional.
Firebase AI Logic sends it to Gemini, in the cloud.
Gemini turns it into a procedure pack, with clear limits and a short card for each step.

title: Supervisor approves
lines: Every limit must quote the manual exactly. The app checks each quote.
Here, Gemini paraphrased a safety line, so the supervisor excludes it.
Only approved items reach technicians.

title: Offline, on-device AI
lines: The technician starts the round. The pack is saved on the device.
Now the connection drops.
The technician notes a faint rattle near the pump.
This is hybrid inference. The same Firebase AI Logic call now runs Gemini Nano, on the device, offline.

title: Rules flag the reading
lines: Next, an abnormal reading: eighty-two degrees.
No AI judges this number. A rule compares it with the approved limit, quotes the manual, and shows the approved escalation.
This check also failed on an earlier shift.

title: Cloud follow-up
lines: Vibration is also high, with a squeal near the bearing.
For a cloud review, the technician sees exactly what will be sent, and agrees.
Offline, the request waits on the device.
When the connection returns, Gemini in the cloud reviews it, with the manual and the history.

title: Handover
lines: At the end, the device drafts the shift handover, based on the recorded readings.
With Rounds, the cloud prepares the knowledge, the device helps offline, and approved rules decide what is safe.
